text:
Priya Rao: Sharing follow-up from the cache-eviction postmortem. Need owners + Jira links for all action items. Quick responses pls so we can lock timelines.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: PM-2026-cache-eviction (automated) :white_check_mark:

Marco Li: I'll take action 1 (investigate hot-shard detection + alerting). ETA 2w. I'll create a Jira. @Ben can you review the alert thresholds?

Ben Carter: @Marco yep, happy to review. Can you add the proposed thresholds in the ticket? I'll +1 after a quick test.

Marco Li: Created Jira RINF-2487 - "hot-shard detection + alerting for kv-cache". Description + proposed thresholds in the first comment. Assigning to me, reviewers: Ben Carter, Sofia.

Sofia Mendes: I'll own action 2 (run post-deployment load tests with quantization changes). Need a checklist and test env. Assigning myself but need infra help for staging GPUs.

Priya Rao: Action 3 is remediation docs + runbook update. Who can take docs + RACI for on-call handoff? Prefer someone familiar with SRE runbooks.

Ben Carter: I can draft the runbook, but handoff to oncall should be with Sofia since she'll run the tests. I'll open RINF-2488 for the runbook and link.

Jira Bot: Issue created: RINF-2488 "kv-cache eviction runbook and remediation playbook" (assignee: Ben Carter).

Sofia Mendes: I'll coordinate handoff with eng-oncall next Wed 10am PT. Can @Priya confirm the invite and attendees?

Priya Rao: Confirmed — please include eng-sre, eng-runtime on the invite. We'll record the session and add notes to the Jira.

Marco Li: Noting recurring pattern: cache evictions spike after model rollouts with longer seq lengths. Action 4: add rollout gating + automatic fallback to smaller context model when eviction rate > X%. I can prototype a gating policy.

Ben Carter: For the gating policy, add a metric-based rollback trigger and a ticket for QA. I'll pair on the rollback test harness.

Marco Li: Opening RINF-2489 "rollout gating + automatic fallback for high eviction rates". Prototype ETA 3w.

Priya Rao: For RACI, propose: Marco = Responsible for gating prototype, Ben = Consulted for rollback QA, Sofia = Informed + handles SRE handoff, Priya = Accountable for tracking closure and customer comms. Any objections?

Ben Carter: sounds good to me.

Sofia Mendes: works for me.

Priya Rao: Ok locking that in. Action owners + Jira: RINF-2487 (Marco), RINF-2488 (Ben), RINF-2489 (Marco). Please update tickets with acceptance criteria and estimated rollout windows.

Marco Li: I added acceptance criteria to RINF-2487.

Ben Carter: Added runbook draft to RINF-2488 and linked the oncall training agenda.

Sofia Mendes: Created staging env request ticket and linked to RINF-2489 comments.

Priya Rao: Let's re-check status in one week. I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue 9am PT to review progress and unblock any blockers. If anything slips, ping me in this thread.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 7 days (2026-03-31 16:00 UTC).

Marco Li: Noted, thanks.

Ben Carter: Thanks all :thumbsup:

Sofia Mendes: I'll have the test checklist ready before the sync.

Priya Rao: Great — appreciate the quick turn on owners. Closing for now, we'll keep updates in the Jira and this thread for questions.
